title: Mojalaki Country Club

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Elevate your corporate events to new heights at Mojalaki Country Club, where business meets beauty amidst the stunning landscapes of Mt. Kearsarge and the Merrimack River Valley. With a history spanning over a century, from Native American grounds to a family-owned farm and a beloved golf club, Mojalaki has seamlessly transitioned into a beacon for exceptional gatherings. Our state-of-the-art facilities, nestled in a setting that has inspired for generations, are ideal for anything from small business meetings to large corporate galas.
